name: Unifi
description: Pipeline and rules to filter out most of the syslog messages coming from a Unifi site running Network 11 and Unifi OS.

source.@value:
rule "unifi-11-wan-classification"
when
    has_field("unifi_chain") &&
    contains(to_string($message.unifi_chain), "_WAN-")
then
    set_field("unifi_event_type", "wan_firewall");
end

pipeline "UniFi Network 11"
stage 0 match either
rule "unifi-01-firewall"
rule "unifi-02-process"
rule "unifi-03-cef"
stage 1 match either
rule "unifi-11-custom-classification"
rule "unifi-11-dnat-classification"
rule "unifi-11-wan-classification"
rule "unifi-04-dhcp"
rule "unifi-05-dhcp-ip"
rule "unifi-06-diagnostics"
rule "unifi-07-destination-interface"
rule "unifi-08a-tcp-sequence"
rule "unifi-08b-tcp-ack"
rule "unifi-08c-tcp-window"
rule "unifi-08d-tcp-urgent-pointer"
rule "unifi-09-tcp-flags"
rule "unifi-10-udp-length"
rule "unifi-12-cef-action"
rule "unifi-12-cef-destination"
rule "unifi-12-cef-destination-port"
rule "unifi-12-cef-source-mac"
rule "unifi-12-cef-source-port"
rule "unifi-12-cef-standard-source"
rule "unifi-12-cef-unifi-source"
rule "unifi-13-cef-firewall-policy"
rule "unifi-13-cef-ips-signature"
rule "unifi-13-cef-ips-signature-id"
rule "unifi-13-cef-policy-name"
rule "unifi-14-cef-device-and-security"
rule "unifi-14-cef-device-model"
rule "unifi-14-cef-flow-count"
rule "unifi-14-cef-direction"
rule "unifi-14-cef-policy-type"
rule "unifi-14-cef-risk"
rule "unifi-14-cef-total-bytes"
rule "unifi-14-cef-total-packets"
rule "unifi-15-extract-mac-addresses"
end

rule "unifi-11-dnat-classification"
when
    has_field("unifi_chain") &&
    starts_with(to_string($message.unifi_chain), "PREROUTING-DNAT-")
then
    set_field("unifi_event_type", "dnat");
end

rule "unifi-14-cef-device-model"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIsrcClientModel")
then
    set_field("src_model", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIsrcClientModel));
end

rule "unifi-08c-tcp-window"
when has_field("unifi_raw_WINDOW")
then
    set_field("tcp_window", to_long(to_string($message.unifi_raw_WINDOW)));
end

rule "unifi-12-cef-unifi-source"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIsrcClientIp")
then
    set_field("src_ip", to_ip(to_string($message.cef_UNIFIsrcClientIp)));
end

rule "unifi-12-cef-destination-port"
when has_field("cef_dpt")
then
    set_field("dst_port", to_long(to_string($message.cef_dpt)));
end

rule "unifi-12-cef-action"
when has_field("cef_act")
then
    set_field("action", to_string($message.cef_act));
end

rule "unifi-14-cef-policy-type"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIpolicyType")
then
    set_field("policy_type", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIpolicyType));
end

rule "unifi-14-cef-direction"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIdirection")
then
    set_field("direction", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIdirection));
end

rule "unifi-14-cef-total-bytes"
when has_field("cef_UNIFItotalBytes")
then
    set_field("total_bytes", to_long(to_string($message.cef_UNIFItotalBytes)));
end

rule "unifi-13-cef-policy-name"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIpolicyName")
then
    set_field("policy_name", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIpolicyName));
end

rule "unifi-08d-tcp-urgent-pointer"
when has_field("unifi_raw_URGP")
then
    set_field("tcp_urgent_pointer", to_long(to_string($message.unifi_raw_URGP)));
end

rule "unifi-14-cef-device-and-security"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIsrcClientHostname")
then
    set_field("src_hostname", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIsrcClientHostname));
end

rule "unifi-12-cef-standard-source"
when has_field("cef_src")
then
    set_field("src_ip", to_ip(to_string($message.cef_src)));
end

rule "unifi-12-cef-source-mac"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIsrcClientMac")
then
    set_field("src_mac", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIsrcClientMac));
end

rule "unifi-05-dhcp-ip"
when
    has_field("dhcp_event") &&
    has_field("client_ip")
then
    set_field(
        "client_ip",
        to_ip(to_string($message.client_ip))
    );
end

rule "unifi-08b-tcp-ack"
when has_field("unifi_raw_ACK")
then
    set_field("tcp_ack", to_long(to_string($message.unifi_raw_ACK)));
end

rule "unifi-13-cef-ips-signature-id"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIipsSignatureId")
then
    set_field("ips_signature_id", to_long(to_string($message.cef_UNIFIipsSignatureId)));
end

rule "unifi-07-destination-interface"
when
    has_field("unifi_raw_OUT")
then
    set_field(
        "dst_interface",
        to_string($message.unifi_raw_OUT)
    );
end

rule "unifi-09-tcp-flags"
when
    has_field("unifi_chain") &&
    contains(to_string($message.message), " SYN ")
then
    set_field("tcp_flags", "SYN");
end

rule "unifi-12-cef-destination"
when has_field("cef_dst")
then
    set_field("dst_ip", to_ip(to_string($message.cef_dst)));
end

rule "unifi-13-cef-firewall-policy"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIfirewallPolicy")
then
    set_field("policy_name", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIfirewallPolicy));
end

rule "unifi-14-cef-total-packets"
when has_field("cef_UNIFItotalPackets")
then
    set_field("total_packets", to_long(to_string($message.cef_UNIFItotalPackets)));
end

rule "unifi-11-custom-classification"
when
    has_field("unifi_chain") &&
    starts_with(to_string($message.unifi_chain), "CUSTOM") &&
    !contains(to_string($message.unifi_chain), "_WAN-")
then
    set_field("unifi_event_type", "custom_firewall");
end

rule "unifi-14-cef-flow-count"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIflowCount")
then
    set_field("flow_count", to_long(to_string($message.cef_UNIFIflowCount)));
end

rule "unifi-14-cef-risk"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIrisk")
then
    set_field("risk", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIrisk));
end

rule "unifi-13-cef-ips-signature"
when has_field("cef_UNIFIipsSignature")
then
    set_field("ips_signature", to_string($message.cef_UNIFIipsSignature));
end

rule "unifi-12-cef-source-port"
when has_field("cef_spt")
then
    set_field("src_port", to_long(to_string($message.cef_spt)));
end

rule "unifi-08a-tcp-sequence"
when has_field("unifi_raw_SEQ")
then
    set_field("tcp_sequence", to_long(to_string($message.unifi_raw_SEQ)));
end
